title: AI-Cowork egress policy (policy.yaml)
description: Kernel 0.0.1. Written once, deliberately (PHILOSOPHY #11). Validated strictly: any unknown key, missing field or bad value makes every egress command refuse. An instance may tighten its preset, never loosen it.

distribution.description: private (also when missing): the instance is never published in any form — no git remotes, no export destinations, backups only. controlled: remotes and exports as listed.

decided.description: when the owner last decided this file

never_export.description: extra globs, added to the kernel's NEVER_EXPORT

remotes.description: git remotes this instance may push to; empty = none

compliance.description: what must never be inside the folder at all (not an egress axis): a file containing a prohibited marker is reported by reach/doctor, refused by triage and by export

prohibited_markers.description: exact, case-sensitive strings — e.g. the employer's classification stamps
